mapper.update: update member_clear_info set status=4, complaint_desc='用户选择不需要清洁，订单取消' where deleted = 0 and room_id = #{roomId} and create_time > now() and status in (0, 1, 2)
mapper.select: select c.*, s.store_name, r.room_name, r.type roomType,su.name userName, o.end_time orderEndTime from member_clear_info c left join member_store_info s on c.store_id = s.store_id left join member_room_info r ON r.room_id = c.room_id left join member_order_info o ON c.order_id = o.order_id left join member_store_user su ON su.store_id = c.store_id and su.user_id = c.user_id where c.clear_id = #{clearId}

select count(1) from member_clear_info where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and status = #{status}
and to_days(create_time)=to_days(#{dateStr}) and DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateStr}, '%Y-%m')
